body:
Preserve the existing dual-profile header diagnostics through `mori check`, normal `mori simulate`, and source-only `mori inspect`. Unknown or malformed Core headers now reach each command's existing error renderer instead of falling through to narrower Core/1 errors.

This integrates the exact three repairs and their three regression files directly on main 71c22f8a. The original production-before blobs match main byte-for-byte. Pending financial, help and installation changes remain separate.

Validation: nine inspected local feature-off commands pass, totaling 18 Rust tests: five new diagnostic tests, the original eight checker cases, and five existing profile/library/simulation controls. The simulation and inspect regressions retain seven complete process captures; checker streams are asserted in memory. All 878 recorded after-source pins match commit 829f4456/tree76dac56a. Edition2024 rustfmt and the six-path diff check pass.

Draft pending a fresh full source/result review of this exact integration. Earlier stacked-tree reviews remain scoped to those earlier trees. Native/target, SDK, proof, wallet and ledger tiers were unrun. Passing these finite controls establishes no independent financial oracle or full-language acceptance.
title: Preserve Core profile errors across public source commands
